_description: Known-good Anthropic OAuth request protocol as implemented by Anvil. Compare mitmproxy captures against this file to detect protocol drift.
_source: Captured from Claude Code CLI v2.1.283 via mitmproxy using OAuth.

auth_oauth._note: OAuth requests use Authorization: Bearer, as verified in the v2.1.283 OAuth-only capture.

must_not_send._note: x-api-key must not be present when using OAuth Bearer auth.
must_not_send.x-api-key: Deleted when using OAuth Bearer auth.

beta_flags._note: Flags are comma-separated in the anthropic-beta header. Order does not matter. oauth-2025-04-20 is present on OAuth requests but absent from API key requests.

billing_header.format: x-anthropic-billing-header: cc_version=<cli_version>.<hash_suffix>; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=<sha256_derived>; cc_prompt_id=<request_uuid>; cc_turn_origin=sdk;
billing_header.position: First system message (prepended before all others). Anvil currently sends cc_entrypoint=cli without the prompt ID or turn origin fields.
billing_header.hash_input: SHA-256 of system prompt text + salt + CLI version.

identity_prefix.text: You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.

stainless_headers_observed._note: These are set by the Anthropic SDK, not by application code. Listed for reference only.
